verdict.rationale: Pipecat's site says developers can swap speech services from any of 200+ integrated providers, usually with one line of code, and its docs describe orchestrating 150+ AI services. A community comment adds that any supported provider can be onboarded in a few lines. That covers the 'plug in multiple TTS providers' half of the story, with voice choice coming from whichever provider is used. Missing for 10: no named list of TTS providers or TTS-specific docs, no evidence of voice selection or a voice library within the framework, and no hands-on proof of switching TTS providers.
